standardStatus.note: ARP is an emerging convention as of 2026-05-13. Ed25519 + JWKS + DID Web below are W3C/IETF-ratified primitives — even agents that do not recognise ARP1 specifically can verify the signatures using standard tooling.

verificationInstructions: For each claim, compute Ed25519.verify(publicKey, claim.canonical, base64decode(claim.signature.value)). Public key may be fetched from the JWKS endpoint, the did.json verificationMethod, or the _arp.meetanlora.com DNS TXT record. All three return the same key.
